I am farming a very small plot here in Kilimanjaro, and for beans I must be careful with money. I will mostly rely on seed I can access, manure if I have it, and family work, because chemical inputs and hired labor are costly. Since this plot is intercropped and rain-fed, I will not plan for irrigation, and I will only use a little pesticide if I see a real problem.
